inputs.text: Five months after the ceasefire was announced, Gaza’s families are still living with fear and displacement instead of safety. Ahmed Baroud, a displaced father of five in Deir al-Balah, describes drones overhead and naval fire putting fishermen’s lives and livelihoods at risk. That is not a real peace for people who cannot safely return, work, or rebuild. Those with power cannot treat a ceasefire as a slogan while civilians bear the costs; protecting people and restoring their ability to earn a living must come first.
